signs.text: SGWD YR EIRA. In Welsh, the Fall of the Snow: a white sheet of the Afon Hepste dropping over a ledge of rock near Ystradfellte. The old path goes in behind the water.

text: The fall is a moving wall of white, seen from the back. It makes a long, soft roar, like standing inside a seashell the size of a house.
Light comes through it green and shaking, and every so often a drip finds your neck on purpose.
Wedged in a dry crack, out of the spray, a ballad sheet that has somehow stayed dry. Somebody planned this.
It is sold by a ford, by the look of it, and it teaches Drench. Which is rich, in here.
